title: Bibiya, gwada kuma karanta sakamakon gaskiya
course_title: Tallace-tallacen Ci gaba: Matsala, Gwaje-gwaje da Ci gaba mai Dorewa

say: Bibiya, gwada, kuma karanta sakamakonku da gaskiya.
Wannan shi ne bidiyo don samfuri na biyu na Tallan Ci gaba.
Ba za ku iya inganta abin da ba za ku iya gani ba, don haka da farko kun saita saƙo mai sauƙi.

say: Ƙungiya ƙungiya ce ta abokan ciniki waɗanda suka fara a cikin wannan watan. Ya fi gaskiya fiye da jimlar tallace-tallace, wanda zai iya tashi tare da ƙarin tallace-tallace yayin da tsofaffin abokan ciniki ke barin shuru.
Misali, Ada a Legas yana da masu saye 80 na farko a watan Janairu.

say: ICE tana ƙididdige kowane ra'ayi daga 1 zuwa 10 akan Tasiri, Amincewa da Sauƙi, sannan ta ƙididdige su. Amsar da sauri Ada ta samu maki 6, 8 da 10, ICE na 8.0. Kayan zaki yakai maki 6.3, sabon talla 5.7.

panel.heading: Makin ICE yana darajar ra'ayoyin Ada
right: App na wayar hannu ta: ICE 4.3

say: Gina app ɗin nata maki 4.3. Tasirin da aka yi tunanin yana da girma, amma ƙoƙari yana da girma kuma shaida yana da bakin ciki. RICE, wanda ke ƙara isa da ƙoƙari a cikin makonni na mutum, kuma yana sanya amsa mai sauri a farko.

say: Ƙananan samfurori suna lilo ba da gangan kuma suna kama da sakamako. Tsarin yatsan yatsa ga mutanen da kuke buƙata kowace ƙungiya shine 16, sau 16 na ƙimar ku na asali, sau ɗaya ya rage wannan ƙimar, raba ta canjin da kuke kula da ku, murabba'i.

panel.heading: Ƙananan zirga-zirga? Gwada manyan canje-canje
items: Kowane rukuni = 16 x p x (1 - p) / d murabba'i
10% zuwa 12%: 3,600 kowace ƙungiya, watanni 4
10% zuwa 14%: 900 kowace ƙungiya, wata ɗaya

say: Misali, kantin sayar da masana'anta na Ngozi yana samun maziyarta kusan 1,800 a wata, tare da adadin kari na kaso 10%. Don gano canji zuwa 12% tana buƙatar 3,600 kowace ƙungiya. Hakan zai ɗauki watanni 4.

say: Don tabo canji zuwa 14% tana buƙatar 900 kawai a kowace rukuni, kusan wata ɗaya. Don haka ta gwada canji mai ƙarfi, ba ƙaramin maɓalli ba.

say: Misali, Amaka ya gwada guntun biya na kwanaki 14. A yana samun sayayya 100 daga baƙi 2,000, 5.0%. B yana samun 130, 6.5%. Darajar z ta kusan 2.04, sama da 1.96, don haka yana da mahimmanci a matakin 5%. Maidowa ya tsaya a 3 a kowane rukuni.

panel.heading: Nasarar gaske ko nasara ta karya?
left: Samfurin da kwanan wata da aka ƙayyade a gaba
right: An zaɓi nasara daga ma'auni da yawa

say: Yi shakkun gwajin tsayawa a lokacin da B ya duba gaba, wanda ke gudana ƴan kwanaki kawai, ko kuma wanda ya kwatanta wannan watan da na ƙarshe. Kuma suna suna babban ma'auni ɗaya a gaba.

say: Hanyar tsaro ma'auni ne wanda dole ne ba zai yi muni ba yayin da kake korar babba. Rangwamen kuɗi na iya ɗaga umarni amma rage riba. Watsa shirye-shiryen yau da kullun na iya ɗaga dannawa amma kawo tubalan.

panel.heading: Kare abokan ciniki yayin da kuke gwadawa

cards.d: Kalli babban gefe, maidowa da gunaguni, ficewa ko toshewa, da lokacin isarwa.
Saƙo kawai mutanen da suka shiga. Fitar da sauƙi. Kar a taɓa siya ko goge lissafin lamba.
Babu ƙididdige ƙididdiga na karya, ɓoyayyun kudade, akwatunan riga-kafi ko saƙo guda 2 na karya kawai.

say: Dokar Kare Bayanai ta Najeriya 2023 tana buƙatar tushen halal, kamar yarda. Riƙe takaddun abokin ciniki na sirri, kuma kada ku buga hotunan kariyar kwamfuta da ke nuna lambobin abokin ciniki.

say: Don tunawa. Bi kowane mataki kuma karanta riƙe ta ƙungiyar ƙungiya. Rubuta hasashe wanda zai iya kasawa, da sanya ra'ayoyi kafin gwaji. Gyara dokoki a gaba, kar a leƙa, da kare abokan ciniki yayin da kuke girma.

panel.heading: Ka tuna
items: Bibiyar kowane mataki; gina teburin ƙungiya
Hasashen da zai iya kasawa
Ra'ayoyi masu daraja tare da ICE ko RICE
Gyara samfurin da ƙarshen kwanan wata; kar a leko
Hanyar tsaro, yarda, babu duhu duhu

say: Yanzu gina jigon ku a cikin takarda ɗaya, tsara gwajin da ya dace na farko, sannan duba sakamakon gwaji tare da gwajin z-gwajin.
Ci gaba da darussan da ke ƙasa.

panel.heading: Ayyukan aikin ku
items: Gina tarin ku a cikin takarda ɗaya
Shirya gwajin da ya dace na farko
Duba sakamakon gwaji
